operation_rules.rationale: Requires the backend and platform-admin guards, verifies archive capability, changes lifecycle state, and verifies the exact archived readback before committing one SQL transaction.
Checks tenant ownership and archive capability, changes lifecycle state, and verifies the scoped readback before committing the same SQL transaction.
Requires the backend and platform-admin guards, verifies the asset update capability, mutates supported fields, and verifies the exact readback before committing one SQL transaction.
Checks tenant ownership and update capability, mutates the asset, and verifies the scoped readback before committing the same SQL transaction.
Reads one active template, executes the established non-writing capability dry-run, and returns a hash-bound preview without creating an envelope.
Applies a capability-envelope-authorized canary closeout only after typed confirmation, then verifies the exact accepted shadow state and consumes the envelope before committing one SQL transaction.
Reads the legacy authority sources and builds a projection plan in memory while the route explicitly reports no apply or external write.
Reads the target member and returns a short-lived signed consent URL without contacting Google or storing OAuth credentials.
Builds an Admin operation context from the authenticated principal and bounded authority reads without creating a run, capability envelope, worker, or artifact.
Builds an Admin repository automation preview in memory and explicitly reports that no mutation was executed.
Checks Admin run access and reads the operation run, steps, and receipts without advancing or mutating the run.
Classifies supplied repository metadata in memory and returns an advisory analysis without provider or Git mutation.
Builds an advisory conflict-resolution plan in memory and does not apply any plan step.
Builds a proposed PR advisory comment but neither posts it nor performs a provider write.
Produces a no-execution resolution preview with provider and branch mutations explicitly disabled.
Computes bounded semantic patch previews from request content without writing repository files.
Reads the three tenant endpoint registrations and builds a sanitized readiness report with execution and provider writes disabled.
Reads one automation run, its steps, and receipts through fixed SELECT queries and returns a sanitized read model.
Requires the backend and platform-admin guards, validates the admin asset capability, creates the asset, and verifies its exact readback before committing one SQL transaction.
Requires the backend and platform-admin guards, verifies restore capability, changes lifecycle state, and verifies the exact active readback before committing one SQL transaction.
Reads ticket and credential-reference metadata to build an activation plan without activating or binding the credential.
Reads the ticket and hold, composes the existing activation dry-run plan, and neither approves the hold nor activates, binds, or sends externally.
Reads ticket and credential-binding state to report delivery readiness without requesting approval or sending externally.
Reads ticket context and builds a secret-reference intake plan without registering, activating, or storing a secret.
Reads ticket execution prerequisites and builds a plan without recording an execution or sending externally.
Evaluates the external-send provider gate and returns a blocked/readiness plan without recording an attempt or dispatching.
Reads ticket context and builds a notification preview without dispatching an adapter or recording delivery.
Lists provider-enablement candidates through a bounded SELECT and does not create a proposal or change dispatch state.
Reads an adapter decision and builds a future-PR scope preview without recording the scope or enabling dispatch.
Reads proposal and adapter metadata to compute a readiness checklist without recording a decision or enabling a provider.
Reads the selected runtime and optional binding, then returns registry health and capability metadata without creating a run or event.
Loads runtime policy context through SELECT queries and evaluates the requested action in memory without starting browser execution.

Serializes bootstrap for the signed user, checks workspace eligibility, optionally creates the tenant and membership, activates Managed mode, and verifies the exact membership and connection before committing one SQL transaction.
Normalizes supplied governance evidence and builds a validation review entirely in memory without activating or persisting the addition.
Returns the fixed MCP protocol and capability handshake without dispatching a tool, querying state, or recording a session.
The compatibility preflight performs a tenant-scoped connection SELECT and reports non-executing readiness metadata only.
Reads one tenant-scoped connection and returns readiness flags while explicitly forbidding decryption, network access, and database execution.
Validates a fixed allowlisted command plan after a tenant-scoped SELECT and explicitly performs no SSH authentication, network access, or command execution.
Reads one tenant-scoped SSH connection and returns readiness flags without decrypting credentials, opening a network connection, or executing a command.
Projects an in-memory conflict analysis into a tenant-safe summary without provider or repository access.
Returns a tenant-scoped advisory plan with route-level execution explicitly disabled.
Returns a tenant-safe dry-run projection with execution and provider writes disabled.
Creates a tenant asset and verifies its scoped readback before committing the same SQL transaction; any mutation or readback failure rolls the transaction back.
Checks tenant ownership and restore capability, changes lifecycle state, and verifies the scoped readback before committing the same SQL transaction.
Resolves authorized memory links through tenant-scoped SELECT queries and explicitly grants no execution authority.
Selects the applicable research policy and builds recommended read-only plan steps without recording an execution.
Resolves layered response-profile metadata through scoped SELECT queries and returns a presentation-only model without persisting state.
Loads engine policy context and evaluates capability readiness without writing a run or validator result.
Reads bounded snapshot-schedule rows and computes readiness in memory while explicitly disabling execution, deletion, archival, and compaction.
Loads the target and approval event through SELECT queries and verifies their exact non-executing metadata without writing a new event.
Reads bounded scheduler-binding metadata and computes a non-executing readiness report without changing a schedule, binding, or approval event.
Reads lifecycle and information-schema metadata to build a census brief without applying lifecycle changes.
Computes proposed lifecycle-registry rows from SELECT-only census data and does not execute the proposed upsert.
Builds a decision brief from registry reads and an in-memory execution envelope; the route does not invoke the separate run writers.
Normalizes an engine task intent in memory and does not create an execution envelope or run.
Verifies active Tenant membership and bounded resource authority, then returns a sanitized operation context without creating or mutating execution state.
Combines Tenant-scoped read authority with an in-memory repository automation preview and performs no mutation or provider dispatch.
Checks Tenant-scoped run ownership and reads the operation run, steps, and receipts without advancing or mutating the run.
Reads brand and CMS grant authority, validates the proposed payload in memory, and explicitly performs no WordPress request or publish.
